title: Toward Cultural Interpretability: A Linguistic Anthropological Framework for Describing and Evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs)

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative transcript analysis of human-chatbot interactions (specifically Bing's Sydney) using linguistic anthropology methods to evaluate the model's communicative competence, embedded sociocultural norms (such as politeness and repetition), and the potential imposition of Anglo-centric or hegemonic interactional norms.

Application of a 'Cultural Interpretability' framework to assess how models handle linguistic variation, stylistic differences, registers, and dialects (including sociolects and ethnolects), focusing on the potential marginalization of minoritized speech communities and low-resource languages.
